description: Hosts that answer scripted source checks with a bot challenge but serve the cited document to a real browser. A match never marks a URL reachable: tools/check-sources.mjs records reachable: false with access_protected: true, and tools/verify.mjs --release accepts a Verified record only if its host, HTTP status and record id are listed here. Each entry must be re-confirmed in a browser; it is evidence, not a blanket bypass.

hosts.rationale: State Bank of Pakistan web application firewall returns HTTP 403 to curl, including with a browser user agent, while the circular pages open normally in a browser.
